memoryBuilder.verseText: Is anything too hard for God? No. Nothing at all.

sequence.prompt: How did God keep His promise to Sarah? Put it in order.

items.label: Three visitors came to the tent
The Lord said Sarah would have a son
Sarah laughed — it seemed too late
One year later, baby Isaac was born

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: She thought it was far too late
This time it was pure joy

application.question: Nothing is too hard for God. What feels impossible to you right now?
application.followUp: Sarah waited almost ninety years — and God was not late. Your impossible thing is not too hard for Him either.
